skillsSnapshot.prompt:
The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

<available_skills>
  <skill>
    <name>acp-router</name>
    <description>Route plain-language requests for Pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, or ACP harness work into either OpenClaw ACP runtime sessions or direct acpx-driven sessions ("telephone game" flow). For coding-agent thread requests, read this skill first, then use only `sessions_spawn` for thread creation.</description>

  </skill>

    <name>feishu-doc</name>
    <description>Feishu document read/write operations. Activate when user mentions Feishu docs, cloud docs, or docx links.
</description>

  </skill>

    <name>feishu-drive</name>

  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-asr</name>
    <description>Convert speech audio to text using Coze ASR. Use when you need to transcribe spoken content from a remote audio URL or a local audio file into plain text.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/extensions/coze-openclaw-plugin/skills/coze-asr/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-image-gen</name>

  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-tts</name>
    <description>Convert text to speech using Coze TTS. Use when you need to synthesize spoken audio from one text input or multiple text segments, optionally with a specific speaker, format, sample rate, or speech settings.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/extensions/coze-openclaw-plugin/skills/coze-tts/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>openclaw-faq</name>
    <description>OpenClaw/龙虾/扣子常见问题解答助手。当用户遇到启动问题、服务中断、模型调用失败、飞书集成问题，或对 OpenClaw、Coze、龙虾有疑问时召回此技能。

通过阅读官方 FAQ 文档帮助用户找到解决方案或指导操作步骤。
</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/extensions/coze-openclaw-plugin/skills/openclaw-faq/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>healthcheck</name>
    <description>Host security hardening and risk-tolerance configuration for OpenClaw deployments.     <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/healthcheck/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>node-connect</name>
    <description>Diagnose OpenClaw node connection and pairing failures for Android, iOS, and macOS companion apps. Use when QR/setup code/manual connect fails, local Wi-Fi works but VPS/tailnet does not, or errors mention pairing required, unauthorized, bootstrap token invalid or expired, gateway.bind, gateway.remote.url, Tailscale, or plugins.entries.device-pair.config.publicUrl.</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/node-connect/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>skill-creator</name>
    <description>Create, edit, improve, or audit AgentSkills. Use when creating a new skill from scratch or when asked to improve, review, audit, tidy up, or clean up an existing skill or SKILL.md file. Also use when editing or restructuring a skill directory (moving files to references/ or scripts/, removing stale content, validating against the AgentSkills spec). Triggers on phrases like "create a skill", "author a skill", "tidy up a skill", "improve this skill", "review the skill", "clean up the skill", "audit the skill".</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/skill-creator/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>tmux</name>

  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>weather</name>
    <description>Get current weather and forecasts via wttr.in or Open-Meteo. Use when: user asks about weather, temperature, or forecasts for any location. NOT for: historical weather data, severe weather alerts, or detailed meteorological analysis. No API key needed.</description>
    <location>/usr/lib/node_modules/openclaw/skills/weather/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>李小军-缠论交易顾问</name>
    <description>李晓军（李小军）- 简约缠论交易思维顾问

山东神光咨询服务有限责任公司负责人，缠论践行者、推广者，出版《零基础学缠论》。
专注于缠中说禅技术分析体系，擅长通过中枢、背驰、走势类型进行市场分析和交易决策。

核心理念：
- 走势终完美：任何走势类型终将完成
- 中枢震荡：把握级别与结构的对应关系
- 背驰判断：识别走势力度衰减的信号
- 分型与笔：从最基础的元素构建分析框架
- 多级别联立：1分钟、5分钟、30分钟、日线多周期共振
</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/li-xiaojun-chanlun/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>auto-trading-strategy</name>
    <description>Professional trading strategy guides for prediction markets and crypto. Risk management, trend analysis, and best practices.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/auto-trading-strategy/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>backtest-expert</name>
    <description>Expert guidance for systematic backtesting of trading strategies. Use when developing, testing, stress-testing, or validating quantitative trading strategies. Covers "beating ideas to death" methodology, parameter robustness testing, slippage modeling, bias prevention, and interpreting backtest results. Applicable when user asks about backtesting, strategy validation, robustness testing, avoiding overfitting, or systematic trading development.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/backtest-expert/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>china-stock-analysis</name>
    <description>Analyze Chinese stock prices (A-shares, HK stocks) and provide investment recommendations. Use when the user asks about stock analysis for Chinese companies, including buying/selling recommendations and market trends.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/china-stock-analysis/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>cli-hub-meta-skill</name>
    <description>Discover agent-native CLIs for professional software. Access the live catalog to find tools for creative workflows, productivity, AI, and more.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/cli-anything/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-voice-gen</name>
    <description>Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Speech-to-Text (ASR) using coze-coding-dev-sdk. Returns results directly to stdout.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/coze-voice-gen/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-web-fetch</name>
    <description>Fetch and extract content from URLs using coze-coding-dev-sdk. Supports web pages, PDF, Office documents (doc/docx/ppt/pptx/xls/xlsx/csv), text files, e-books (epub/mobi), XML, and images. Returns structured content with text, images, and links.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/coze-web-fetch/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>coze-web-search</name>
    <description>Search the web using coze-coding-dev-sdk. Supports web search, image search, AI summaries, time filters, and site restrictions.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/coze-web-search/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>crypto-backtest</name>
    <description>Crypto futures backtesting engine with built-in EMA, RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Band strategies. Fetches OHLCV data from any ccxt-supported exchange (Bybit, Binance, OKX, etc.), runs multi-strategy sweeps, calculates win rate / PnL / drawdown, and exports results to JSON. Use when backtesting trading strategies, comparing parameter combinations, evaluating crypto trading signals, or building a quantitative trading pipeline.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/crypto-backtest/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>earnings-reader</name>
    <description>A股财报研读助手 - 解读利润表/资产负债表/现金流量表</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/earnings-reader/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>financial-analyst</name>
    <description>Financial analysis and research workflows for market research, equity research, comparable companies, precedent transactions, and DCF valuation. Use when asked to build or critique DCF models, comps/precedents tables, competitor or strategy analysis, market sizing, or to deliver analyst-ready outputs in Excel, PowerPoint, or Markdown from CSV/Excel/SQL/API/web data.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/financial-analyst/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>fundamental-stock-analysis</name>
    <description>Fundamental equity analysis and peer ranking using a structured scoring playbook (quality, balance-sheet safety, cash flow, valuation, sector adjustments, confidence modifiers). Use when a user asks to analyze one or more stock tickers, compare peers, choose a best pick, or produce a fundamentals-based verdict.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/fundamental-stock-analysis/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>risk-management-specialist</name>

Use when user mentions risk management, ISO 14971, risk analysis, FMEA, fault tree analysis, hazard identification, risk control, risk matrix, benefit-risk analysis, residual risk, risk acceptability, or post-market risk.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/risk-management-specialist/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>Trading</name>
    <description>Trading analysis and education. Technical analysis, chart patterns, risk management, and position sizing for stocks, forex, and crypto.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/trading/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>trading-signal</name>
    <description>Subscribe and retrieve on-chain Smart Money signals. Monitor trading activities of smart money addresses,
including buy/sell signals, trigger price, current price, max gain, and exit rate.
Use this skill when users are looking for investment opportunities — smart money signals can serve as valuable references for potential trades.
</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/trading-signal/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>

    <name>us-stock-analysis</name>

Use when user requests analysis of US stock tickers (e.g., "analyze AAPL", "compare TSLA vs NVDA", "give me a report on Microsoft"), evaluation of financial metrics, technical chart analysis, or investment recommendations for American stocks.</description>
    <location>/workspace/projects/workspace/skills/us-stock-analysis/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>
